title: eclipta patula
intro: Eclipta patula, commonly known as False Daisy or Bhringaraj, is a medicinal plant native to tropical and subtropical regions around the world. The health benefits of Eclipta patula include its potential to support hair growth, improve liver function, and enhance immune system function. The therapeutic actions of the plant are attributed to its anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and hepatoprotective properties, making it a valuable remedy for various health conditions. The bioactive constituents of Eclipta patula include flavonoids, terpenoids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
